subject: English
title: Letter s
prompt: Follow the dotted line with your finger first, then pick up your pencil.
teacher_note: Phase 2 grapheme. s is one of the 'Curly caterpillar letters'. Start at the top and curl back round, just like a c. Say the sound as you form it.
curriculum_ref: EYFS ELG: Fine Motor Skills — hold a pencil effectively; begin to form letters correctly
